faq_expansion.q: How do I compare personal injury lawyers locally?
faq_expansion.a: Use the same criteria for every lawyer: relevant accident experience, fee clarity, communication process, evidence plan, and state-bar status checks.

faq_expansion.q: What should I ask about fees?
faq_expansion.a: Ask whether the fee is contingency-based, whether case costs are deducted before or after the fee, and what costs may be owed if there is no recovery.
